children: -- OPPEIN has been recognized by Frost & Sullivan as the Global No. 1 Brand in the Customized Home Furnishings Market in 2025, further reinforcing the company's position as a leading provider of whole-house customization solutions. The recognition is based on a rigorous assessment of the brand's overall business performance and market presence, underscoring OPPEIN's sustained growth and expanding global footprint.

Established in 1994, OPPEIN Home Group Inc. has evolved from a kitchen cabinet manufacturer into a comprehensive home furnishing company serving residential and commercial customers worldwide. Its product range includes

, bathroom vanities, interior doors, customized furniture, and integrated whole-house solutions designed to meet different lifestyle preferences and project requirements. To complement this, the company has developed a multi-brand portfolio, including OPPEIN, OPPOLIA, miform, BAUNIS, and others, with each brand positioned to target distinct customer segments.

Powering the company's growth is a manufacturing network engineered to support large-scale customization. OPPEIN operates five intelligent manufacturing bases with a combined construction area exceeding 3 million square meters. At full capacity, the factories can produce up to 142,350 custom cabinets each day. AI-assisted design tools are integrated with intelligent manufacturing processes, allowing efficient customization from design through production and delivery. This integrated approach streamlines lead times while delivering tailored solutions for customers across diverse markets.

OPPEIN's international business has expanded through a retail network of approximately 8,000 showrooms across more than 100 countries and regions. Beyond retail, the company has also established long-term partnerships with developers, contractors, architects, and interior designers, supplying customized furnishing solutions for more than 18,000 residential, commercial, and hospitality developments worldwide. In Australia, OPPEIN supplied customized furnishing solutions for Australia 108, the tallest residential tower in the Southern Hemisphere. In Malaysia, the company delivered thousands of customized cabinetry units for Core Residence @ TRX in Kuala Lumpur, supporting one of the country's landmark residential developments.

As demand for customized living spaces continues to grow, OPPEIN continues to expand its global presence while investing in manufacturing, product innovation, and customer service. The company continues to work with business partners around the world through both contract project collaboration and its international franchise network. For more information about OPPEIN’s products and its global franchise opportunities, please visit www.oppeinhome.com.
